profile.name: Lucy
profile.review:
Lucy is a 5-star Spectro Pistols DPS from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab who relies on a mechanic called Hack (a variant of Tune Rupture) and a special Ultimate that applies various debuffs and damage to enemies. Lucy’s rotation goal will be to empower that Ultimate to deal as much damage and apply as many debuffs as possible, while also dealing some Hack damage to her targets. Her kit is intrinsically tied to her best Support, Rebecca, from the same collab, as they rely on each other to enhance their damage and make for the best team they can get.

Key Mechanics

Lucy’s main rotation focus lies in her Forte resources, being TCP and Root Access. First, she wants to charge up TCP to cast an enhanced Skill called “Deadlock” that then enables her to accumulate Root Access via newly acquired Basic Attacks. At full Root Access, she can then cast a special Heavy Attack called Dual Threading, automatically followed by Multi-threading. At this point, her Ultimate is enhanced, and she is free to cast it and switch out.

Lucy’s Ultimate is, however, very unique. It freezes all enemies in time for its duration and allows you to select 7 different programs that will debuff or deal damage to enemies depending on the program. Until S2,  where all programs are always selectable, the first 5 programs are always the best ones to pick for a mix of damage and damage enhancements.

Lastly, Lucy has a unique Tune Break response, called Hack. This is functionally the same thing as Tune Rupture; the damage multipliers function in the exact same way; they’re just under a different name. Lucy will apply Hack - Shifting through various attacks on targets that, upon casting a Tune Break Skill, will receive additional Hack damage, empowering your overall damage per Tune Break Skill cast.

Rotation & Passives

Lucy’s rotation has her casting her Skills 1 and 2 (“Payload” and “Pulse Interference”) following her Intro in order to regenerate TCP passively while she is on-field after the casts and immediately activating her Signature Weapon’s passives. Afterwards, Lucy has enough TCP to cast her enhanced Skill with the help of 3 Basic Attacks. Finally, a full Basic Attack chain is enough to restore her Root Access fully, at which point she can cast her full Forte Heavy Attack, Ultimate, and swap out. No other attacks are useful in her rotation, and dodging isn’t ideal as it’ll lose time overall, so overall Lucy is unfortunately quite prone to interruption.

When it comes to her passives, they only help her consistency slightly in the case of her Inherent Skill 1 (even still, it’s quite useless), and her Inherent Skill 2 grants a nichely accessed damage-increasing mark debuff to enemies that can be granted to her and Rebecca when a boss enemy is defeated. This is particularly useful in early Matrix rounds, but may also see small benefits in Tower of Adversity 2-4, giving Lucy’s team a small extra advantage in those areas.

Meta Position & Conclusion

As a stand-alone modern mid-3.x DPS release, Lucy’s own damage ceiling isn’t impressive compared to all the DPS powerhouses released before her. Aemeath, Luuk, Sigrika, Hiyuki all significantly outperform her, as her own damage ceiling can be compared to that of Augusta or Phrolova, even in her best team with Rebecca and Mornye/Shorekeeper. All in all, while Lucy is easy to access teams-wise since she’s using a free buffer and generalist Supports, her damage ceiling is unimpressive for a modern release, but still usable. Those who enjoy Lucy as a character from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners may be satisfied with how she turned out, as she is easily serviceable, but as a modern release, for meta-only players with no attachment to Lucy, she is forgettable. Targeting the other modern 3.x teams instead may prove to be a stronger choice if meta performance is your only deciding factor.

In conclusion, while Lucy doesn’t bring much that’s new meta-wise to the table, and her long-term use cases don’t look great at S0 due to Hack being different from Tune Rupture, she is still quite a serviceable DPS character up to the late 2.x versions’ standard which can help fill out your roster, or let you play a really cool Cyberpunk: Edgerunners character. And we think that’s awesome.
profile.pros:
• Accessible - has a free best-in-slot buffer and can use multiple generalist Supports to great effect, all of them not needing their Signature to perform near maximum level.

  • High Sequence value; S1 increases her Whimpering Wastes potential substantially, plus S2-S3 can increase her longevity across all game modes by a lot.
profile.cons:
• Has a lower damage ceiling than every modern release before her (about equivalent to a late 2.x character).

  • Pretty Signature weapon-dependent to perform at a standard modern level.

  • Second Inherent Skill (which can boost her damage a decent amount) will almost never activate aside from very specific conditions (Killing an almost-dead Matrix boss, Tower of Adversity 2-4).

  • The Hack mechanic is exclusive to the Edgerunners collab characters, and is a variation of Tune Rupture unable to benefit from standard Tune Rupture temporary buffs in endgame content, impacting long-term use in such scenarios.

  • Collab character - will likely never rerun beyond her first banner. If you don’t have her right now, you’ve most likely missed out forever.

profile.rotations:
Rotation & Gameplay

The focus of Lucy’s rotation is to build towards her Forte Heavy Attack by quickly building TCP and Root Access to then access her enhanced Ultimate at the end of her rotation. It’s possible to optimize this and the uptime on her Ultimate’s debuffs, as follows:

Echo Timing

Summon Adam Smasher at any point in her rotation.

Opener “Rotation”

Lucy wants to act as the very first character in your team rotation. This is because before coming back to her, in her best teams, over 25 seconds of rotation time will need to be expended before her Ultimate needs to be used again. Hence, she can use it immediately and get all of her debuffs up:

  • Ultimate (First 5 Programs) (Swap)

The first 5 Programs, starting from the top, are always optimal to utilize for maximum damage and damage-increasing debuffs. At S2, using all 7 Programs becomes possible, but this only brings small amounts of utility.

Loop Rotation

Following her immediate Ultimate cast, when it’s finally Lucy’s turn to Intro in after both of her teammates’ buffs have been set up through their own rotations, Lucy rotates like so:

  • Intro

  • Skill: Payload

  • Skill: Pulse Interference

  • Basic 2

  • Basic 3

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation endlag via Skill)

  • Skill: Deadlock

  • Basic: Thread 1

  • Basic: Thread 2

  • Basic: Thread 3

  • Basic: Thread 4

  • Heavy: Dual-threading

  • Heavy: Multi-threading (Cancel animation endlag via Ultimate)

  • Ultimate (First 5 Programs)

  • Outro

Additional Tips & Tricks

In Quickswap, her first and second Skill are able to be used at vastly different times. You may keep this in mind when crafting rotations around this mechanic.

Additionally, her base form Heavy Attacks have decent damage and Off-Tune Buildup, which could be useful if you have time to spare in your team’s rotation. They may also work towards building up her Skill: Deadlock, so her on-field rotation (the part where she can’t Quickswap as she is being Outro buffed by Rebecca) only includes the cast of this Skill and what follows after it.

skills.name: Basic Attack - Locked Thread
skills.description:
Basic Attack

  • Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.

  • Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack

  • Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack

  • Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

  • Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.

  • Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.

  • Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading

  • When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.

  • Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading

  • Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.

  • Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.

skills.name: Protocol Breach
skills.description:
Resonance Skill - Payload

  • Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

  • Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference

  • Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake.

  • Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock

  • When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.

  • Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

  • Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

  • Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

multipliers.Name: Resonance Skill - Payload Follow-Up Attack DMG

skills.name: Netrunner
skills.description:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner

  • Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 points of RAM.

  • While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.

  • While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, press Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets.

  • Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping

  • Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction

  • Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.

Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol

  • Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.

Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout

  • Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement

  • Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.

Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch

  • Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be nullified for 30s.

Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis

  • Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.

  • After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.

  • Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

multipliers.Name: Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive: Override DMG

skills.name: Depths of Blackwall
skills.description:
Cloud Portal

  • When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.

  • Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction

  • After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 stack of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.

  • While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.

  • When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.

  • When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.

  • When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.

  • After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

  • After casting Resonance Liberation, or if no attacks are performed within 8s after casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state.

Hack Response - Data Crash

  • Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.

  • Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s.

TCP

  • Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.

  • Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.

  • Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.

  • After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

Root Access

  • Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.

  • Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Heavy Attack - Dual Threading , Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

skills.name: Ghost Cyberware
skills.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stack of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stack by default.

Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stack of Optical Illusion.

skills.name: Function Cracking
skills.description:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock hits an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor: Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. Gaining this effect again resets its duration. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

skills.name: Outdated Hallucination
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.

If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

skills.name: Countermeasure Program
skills.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.

Grants all Resonators in the team Countermeasure Program for 25s.

While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.

While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Countermeasure Program is active. Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets the effective charge.

When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the Countermeasure Program early.

skills.name: Data Crash
skills.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lucy can cast Tune Break on the target.

Responding to Hack - Interfered: when Resonators in the team trigger Tune Break on the target and cause them to be affected by Hack - Interfered, Lucy applies Hack Response - Data Crash on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to 1 time every 8s.

weapons.Comment: Lucy's Signature is a huge stat-stick for her that grants her big Spectro DMG Bonus, Heavy DMG Amplification and Heavy DMG DEF Ignore bonuses, making it far stronger than any other options she has access to. Strongly recommended pull if you plan to get Lucy.

Galbrena's Signaure grants Lucy a very easy to access Heavy DMG Amplification and DEF Ignore buff that can apply to the latter half of her rotation, where a majority of her damage is dealt. Only strong alternative to her Signature if available.

Rebecca's Signature is best used on her instead of Lucy, but if you somehow acquire it and don't want to use it on Rebecca, Lucy can increase party-wide ATK using it. Generally not recommended but theoretically possible.

Strongest permanently available option for all Pistol main damage dealers, granting universal ATK, CRIT and DMG Bonus buffs to any character upon dealing Tune Break damage. Overall a good choice if you time your Tune Break Skill casts in a team with Shorekeeper (or in WhiWa), falls behind significantly with Mornye though.
Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Lucy, who barely benefits from this weapon's Basic DMG-increasing effects.
Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Lucy, who barely benefits from this weapon's Skill DMG-increasing effects.

Fallback permanent option if Phasic Homogenizer isn't available. Its passive effect is barely beneficial to Lucy teams, however the stats it gives may help with meeting Energy Regen requirements if necessary.
Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Lucy, who does not benefit from this weapon's Aero Erosion-related effects.
This Battle Pass exclusive is the best 4-star choice for Lucy thanks to its ability to increase her ATK and Heavy DMG while still granting CRIT buffs. Does not compare to any 5-star choice though.

Another fallback option that's even weaker than Static Mist while still helping to alleviate Energy Regen requirements. A low Base ATK and no CRIT-increasing effect makes this weapon much less preferred than 5-star choices.
Best no-gacha option if necessary, granting some extra ATK when no damage is taken by the character equipping it. Upgrade to 5-star options as soon as possible though.

teams.Name: Best Team
teams.Comments: Shorekeeper may prove stronger in Whimpering Wastes as building Off-Tune multiple times on the same enemy (the reason why Mornye is ran) will almost never happen in that gamemode.

synergies.Comment: Lucy's best partner by far, Rebecca has a kit that's intrinsically tied to Lucy as her own kit mentions Rebecca by name several times throughout. Able to provide a variety of unique buffs, personal damage, and significant Hack synergy, Lucy and Rebecca pair seamlessly together in a way where she is the only character strong enough to have Lucy reveal her true potential - no alternative comes close.

Lucy can use a variety of generalist Supports for her team's third slot, Mornye being ideal to put the highest emphasis possible on Hack damage via her ability to increase the team's Off-Tune Buildup Rate. However, Shorekeeper is a very close second that can serve almost exactly as effectively thanks to her CRIT buffs (and even see better results in Whimpering Wastes where building off-tune multiple times on the same enemy will almost never happen), and Verina is the generalist fallback permanently accessible option that will not be as strong, but make for a capable team overall still.
